profile.name: Hugo Bayoud
profile.headline: React Native / Expo mobile developer · NestJS & TypeScript · B2C apps
profile.tagline: 6+ years of experience with a strongly product-driven approach: UX, architecture, development and launch.

items.summary: Worked on a sports-dating app used by 200,000 people. Designed the profile completion flow to raise profile quality and improve matching. Led a major part of the migration of the internal management tools from Next.js to a TanStack SPA backed by an AdonisJS API, inside a five-project monorepo.

Built an internal tool automating the whole publishing chain for tech content on X: viral topic detection through MCP integrations, gathering and summarising with several AI models, editorial generation, a control dashboard, and cron-job orchestration all the way to publication.

Co-created a FinTech that analyses a financial situation in under five minutes using AI, then anonymously connects users with certified advisers. Designed and built the React Native/Expo mobile app, the NestJS/TypeScript back end and the Next.js back office. Backed by a €110k funding round.

A six-month engagement supporting the launch of Sapio, a general-knowledge mobile app that grew from 0 to over 50,000 users. Designed the data architecture on Google Cloud/Firebase, built React Native screens and supported the V1 release on the App Store and Google Play.

testimonial.author: Jean Baptiste Thouard
testimonial.quote:
We had the opportunity to work with Hugo for 6 months (April to September 2025), from design to the release of Sapio, our general-knowledge mobile app.

He demonstrated a strong command of React Native and its ecosystem, both back end and front end: he built the app's entire logic, set up a large part of the back end, implemented an advanced push notification system, and created gamified interfaces and new game modes.

We particularly appreciated Hugo's ability to organise himself (both independently and within the team) and his responsiveness — always with a smile. His work is consistently clear, well presented and documented.

Thanks to his work, we were able to ship a stable version of our app quickly.

items.summary: Designed and built the entire NestJS back end of a mobile app for sharing group expenses: REST APIs, settlement calculations, business logic, authentication and security. Contributed to product and UX decisions, set up the deployment pipelines and supported the store releases.

Back-end development inside the monorepo powering the MyBus and MaaSify mobility products. Integrated a journey-planning engine and contributed to the dematerialisation of transport tickets, in a Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL and GitLab CI/CD environment.

education.detail: Two years of French preparatory classes at CIV in Sophia Antipolis, then three years of engineering school at ISIMA in Clermont-Ferrand.

ai.text: AI-assisted development: structured workflows with Claude or Codex, regular testing of frontier models and continuous monitoring of the field.
